#!/bin/bash
# SEAT S34 — independent review harness for tools/souji-verify.sh (souji-shokunin r2).
# Builds spec-derived fixtures under a fresh mktemp -d (/tmp) and grades the tool
# under review against an oracle derived ONLY from tools/souji-verify.spec.md.
#
# Sandbox discipline: every git mutation happens under $LAB (/tmp). Live repos are
# never touched mutably. No banned verbs (fetch/push/commit/branch/checkout/reset/
# rebase) are used: fixture history is built with plumbing (commit-tree/update-ref/
# symbolic-ref) plus `git worktree add` inside the sandbox.
set -euo pipefail

TOOL="${TOOL:-}"
[ -n "$TOOL" ] || { echo "usage: TOOL=/path/to/souji-verify.sh $0 [LABDIR]" >&2; exit 9; }
LAB="${1:-$(mktemp -d /tmp/souji-review34-lab.XXXXXX)}"
case "$LAB" in /tmp/*) ;; *) echo "LAB must be under /tmp" >&2; exit 9;; esac
mkdir -p "$LAB"
FLEET="$LAB/fleet"; PLAIN="$LAB/plain"; RUNS="$LAB/runs"
mkdir -p "$FLEET" "$PLAIN" "$RUNS"

export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=fixture GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.invalid
export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=fixture GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.invalid
export GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES="$LAB"
export TZ=UTC LANG=C

CASES="$LAB/cases.tsv"; : > "$CASES"
# id  kind  path  expect3  re4_primary  re4_alt  notes
case_row() { printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$5" "$6" "$7" >> "$CASES"; }

sha() { sha256sum -- "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; }

mkrepo() { # dir -> echoes initial commit sha (README-only)
  git init -q -b master "$1"
  printf 'fixture %s\n' "${1##*/}" > "$1/README.md"
  git -C "$1" add -A
  local t s; t=$(git -C "$1" write-tree)
  s=$(printf 'init\n' | git -C "$1" commit-tree "$t")
  git -C "$1" update-ref refs/heads/master "$s"
  printf '%s\n' "$s"
}

commit_on() { # repo ref msg file...
  local r=$1 ref=$2 msg=$3; shift 3
  local f; for f in "$@"; do mkdir -p "$(dirname "$r/$f")"; printf '%s: %s\n' "$f" "$msg" > "$r/$f"; done
  git -C "$r" add -A -- .
  local t s; t=$(git -C "$r" write-tree)
  s=$(printf '%s\n' "$msg" | git -C "$r" commit-tree "$t" -p "$(git -C "$r" rev-parse "$ref")")
  git -C "$r" update-ref "$ref" "$s"
  printf '%s\n' "$s"
}

g() { # name args... -> runs tool, captures out/err/rc; SHOKUNIN_ROOT override
  local name=$1; shift
  set +e
  ( cd -- "$LAB" && SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$FLEET" bash "$TOOL" "$@" ) > "$RUNS/$name.out" 2> "$RUNS/$name.err"
  echo $? > "$RUNS/$name.rc"
  set -e
}

git -C "$P10" update-ref refs/heads/sideline "$A10"

#!/bin/bash
# SEAT S34 — phase 2: selftest, static safety audit, live-tree checks.
# Read-only over live repos: only rev-parse / log / worktree list and
# `git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain` (the global flag form), plus the
# tool under review. No mutating git commands are issued here.
set -euo pipefail
TOOL="${1:?usage: phase2.sh TOOL OUTDIR}"
OUT="${2:?outdir}"
ROOT=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin
mkdir -p "$OUT"

# Emulate deployment inference (real script lives in $ROOT/souji-shokunin/tools):
# the pinned copy needs the root and ledger spelled out explicitly.
export SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$ROOT"
export SOUJI_LEDGER="$ROOT/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"

run() { # name cmd...
  local name=$1; shift
  set +e
  "$@" > "$OUT/$name.out" 2> "$OUT/$name.err"
  echo $? > "$OUT/$name.rc"
  set -e
}

t0=$(date +%s.%N)
run selftest1 bash "$TOOL" --selftest
t1=$(date +%s.%N)
run selftest2 bash "$TOOL" --selftest
t2=$(date +%s.%N)
printf 'selftest1_s=%s\nselftest2_s=%s\n' "$(awk -v a=$t0 -v b=$t1 'BEGIN{printf "%.2f", b-a}')" "$(awk -v a=$t1 -v b=$t2 'BEGIN{printf "%.2f", b-a}')" > "$OUT/selftest-timing.txt"

# ---- static safety audit -------------------------------------------------
{
  echo '== banned-verb scan (subcommand position) =='
  grep -nE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])(git|fixture_git)[[:space:]]+(-[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+)*("?)(fetch|push|commit|checkout|reset|rebase)([[:space:]]|$)' "$TOOL" || true
  grep -nE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+(-C[[:space:]]+"?[^[:space:]"]+"?[[:space:]]+)?branch([[:space:]]|$)' "$TOOL" || true
  echo '== commit-tree occurrences (fixture-only?) =='
  grep -n 'commit-tree' "$TOOL" || true
  echo '== write-ish operations =='
  grep -nE '(^|[^|])>{1,2}[^&]|mktemp|mkdir|rm -[rf]|mv |cp |tee |chmod ' "$TOOL" || true
  echo '== secret-shaped handling =='
  grep -nE 'secret|credential|\.env|\.pem|id_\*' "$TOOL" | head -20
  echo '== exit statements =='
  grep -nE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])exit[[:space:]]' "$TOOL" || true
  echo '== shebang / set flags =='
  head -3 "$TOOL"
  grep -n '^set ' "$TOOL" || true
  echo '== rg invocations =='
  grep -n 'rg ' "$TOOL" || true
} > "$OUT/static-audit.txt" 2>&1

# ---- live snapshots (read-only) -----------------------------------------
snap() {
  local r
  for r in kotodama-shokunin game-dev-2d-shokunin lore-shokunin souji-shokunin; do
    echo "repo=$r"
    echo "  head=$(git -C "$ROOT/$r" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "  unpushed=$(git -C "$ROOT/$r" log --oneline HEAD --not --remotes 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
    echo "  dirty=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$ROOT/$r" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
    if [ -f "$ROOT/$r/.git/index" ]; then
      echo "  index_md5=$(md5sum "$ROOT/$r/.git/index" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
      echo "  index_mtime=$(stat -c %Y "$ROOT/$r/.git/index")"
    fi
  done
  echo "repo=fleet-root"
  echo "  head=$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)"
  echo "  unpushed=$(git -C "$ROOT" log --oneline HEAD --not --remotes 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
  echo "  dirty=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$ROOT" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
  [ -f "$ROOT/.git/index" ] && echo "  index_md5=$(md5sum "$ROOT/.git/index" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  [ -f "$ROOT/.git/index" ] && echo "  index_mtime=$(stat -c %Y "$ROOT/.git/index")"
}
snap > "$OUT/live-before.txt"

# ---- live targets --------------------------------------------------------
run live_kotodama   bash "$TOOL" "$ROOT/kotodama-shokunin"
run live_fleet_root bash "$TOOL" "$ROOT"
run live_pushed1    bash "$TOOL" "$ROOT/.ufo/interactive-l1-20261015T050057Z/launch-chousa.json"
run live_pushed2    bash "$TOOL" "$ROOT/.ufo/interactive-l1-20261015T050057Z/interactive-panes.json"
run live_lore_B1    bash "$TOOL" /tmp/r87-B1
run live_lore_C5    bash "$TOOL" /tmp/r87-C5
run live_gd2d_r81   bash "$TOOL" /tmp/r81-frozen
run live_gd2d_r80   bash "$TOOL" "$ROOT/r80-baseline-frozen-worktree"
run live_gd2d_r98   bash "$TOOL" "$ROOT/game-dev-2d-shokunin-wt-r98"
run live_gd2d_r99   bash "$TOOL" "$ROOT/game-dev-2d-shokunin-wt-r99"
run live_gd2d_r100  bash "$TOOL" "$ROOT/game-dev-2d-shokunin-wt-r100"
run live_secret     bash "$TOOL" "$ROOT/kotodama-shokunin/.scratch/outside-secret.txt"
run live_batch      bash "$TOOL" \
  "$ROOT/kotodama-shokunin" \
  "$ROOT/.ufo/interactive-l1-20261015T050057Z/launch-chousa.json" \
  /tmp/r87-B1 /tmp/r81-frozen "$ROOT/r80-baseline-frozen-worktree" \
  "$ROOT/game-dev-2d-shokunin-wt-r98" "$ROOT/game-dev-2d-shokunin-wt-r99" "$ROOT/game-dev-2d-shokunin-wt-r100" \
  "$ROOT/kotodama-shokunin/.scratch/outside-secret.txt"

snap > "$OUT/live-after.txt"

# expected-vs-observed (expectations derived from spec + round-1 lane facts)
python3 - "$OUT" <<'PY'
import json, os, re, sys
out = sys.argv[1]

def line(name):
    txt = open(os.path.join(out, name + '.out'), encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read().splitlines()
    for l in txt:
        if l.startswith('VERDICT\t'):
            f = l.split('\t')
            return {'verdict': f[2], 'receipt': f[3], 'evidence': '\t'.join(f[4:])}
    return None

def rc(name):
    return int(open(os.path.join(out, name + '.rc')).read().strip())

def counts(rec):
    m = re.search(r'unpushed=(\d+)\s+dirty=(\d+)', rec['evidence']) if rec else None
    return (int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))) if m else (None, None)

exp = [
    # name, expect verdict, receipt regex, evidence regex, rc, extra
    ('live_kotodama',   'NOT-SAFE', r'^(unpushed-dirty|unpushed|dirty)$', r'unpushed=[0-9]+ dirty=[0-9]+', 0, 'nonzero-count'),
    ('live_fleet_root', 'NOT-SAFE', r'^.*$', r'unpushed=[0-9]+ dirty=[0-9]+', 0, None),
    ('live_pushed1',    'SAFE',     r'^pushed$', r'^.+$', 0, None),
    ('live_pushed2',    'SAFE',     r'^pushed$', r'^.+$', 0, None),
    ('live_lore_B1',    'SAFE',     r'^metadata-prune$', r'unique=0', 0, None),
    ('live_lore_C5',    'SAFE',     r'^metadata-prune$', r'unique=0', 0, None),
    ('live_gd2d_r81',   'SAFE',     r'^metadata-prune$', r'unique=0', 0, None),
    ('live_gd2d_r80',   'SAFE',     r'^metadata-prune$', r'unique=0', 0, None),
    ('live_gd2d_r98',   'NOT-SAFE', r'^unpushed-branch$', r'unpushed=[1-9][0-9]*', 0, None),
    ('live_gd2d_r99',   'NOT-SAFE', r'^unpushed-branch$', r'unpushed=[1-9][0-9]*', 0, None),
    ('live_gd2d_r100',  'NOT-SAFE', r'^unpushed-branch$', r'unpushed=[1-9][0-9]*', 0, None),
    ('live_secret',     'NOT-SAFE', r'^secrets-refusal$', r'^.+$', 0, None),
]
results = []
for name, ev, er, ar, erc, extra in exp:
    got = line(name)
    ok = bool(got) and got['verdict'] == ev and re.search(er, got['receipt']) and re.search(ar, got['evidence']) and rc(name) == erc
    if ok and extra == 'nonzero-count':
        up, di = counts(got)
        ok = (up or 0) > 0 or (di or 0) > 0
    results.append({'check': name, 'expected': {'verdict': ev, 'receipt': er, 'evidence': ar, 'rc': erc},
                    'observed': got, 'rc': rc(name), 'pass': ok})

# ground truth captured immediately before the tool ran (live repos may move)
gt = {}
repo = None
for l in open(os.path.join(out, 'live-before.txt')):
    l = l.rstrip('\n')
    if l.startswith('repo='):
        repo = l[5:]
        gt[repo] = {}
    elif l.startswith('  ') and repo and '=' in l:
        k, v = l.strip().split('=', 1)
        gt[repo][k] = v

json.dump({'checks': results, 'ground_truth_before': gt},
          open(os.path.join(out, 'live-checks.json'), 'w'), indent=1)
print('live checks:', sum(1 for r in results if r['pass']), '/', len(results))
for r in results:
    if not r['pass']:
        print('  FAIL', r['check'], r['observed'], 'rc=', r['rc'])
